crossRefs.note: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and a course of cedar beams.
Whatever more will be needed for the house of your God, which you may have occasion to give, give it out of the king’s…
Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.
The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces…
A multitude of camels will cover you, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah. All from Sheba will come. They will bring…
The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of…

translations.web: with three courses of great stones and a course of new timber. Let the expenses be given out of the king’s house.
translations.bsb: with three layers of cut stones and one of timbers. The costs are to be paid from the royal treasury.
translations.kjv: With three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expenses be given out of the king's house:
